816caa4c746dfd9a.translation: डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से, रोल ओएस केवल **स्थानीय फ़ाइल सिस्टम** पर काम करता है। यह मार्कडाउन टेम्पलेट की प्रतिलिपि बनाता है और आपके रिपॉजिटरी की ⟦0⟧ निर्देशिका में पैकेट/निर्णय/रन फ़ाइलें लिखता है। डिफ़ॉल्ट संचालन कोई नेटवर्क अनुरोध नहीं करता है, कोई गुप्त जानकारी नहीं रखता है, और कोई टेलीमेट्री एकत्र नहीं करता है। कोई खतरनाक संचालन नहीं - सभी फ़ाइल लेखन डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से स्किप-इफ-एग्जिस्ट का उपयोग करते हैं।
816caa4c746dfd9a.source: By default, Role OS operates on the **local filesystem only**. It copies markdown templates and writes packet/verdict/run files to your repository's ⟦0⟧ directory. Default operation makes no network requests, handles no secrets, and collects no telemetry. No dangerous operations — all file writes use skip-if-exists by default.

d33fa30ca9d9ed75.translation: तीन **ऑप्ट-इन** सुविधाएँ हैं जो तब नेटवर्क को छूती हैं जब आप उन्हें स्पष्ट रूप से सक्षम करते हैं:
d33fa30ca9d9ed75.source: Three **opt-in** features touch the network when you explicitly enable them:

ef16e6a5803e1c52.translation:
- **⟦0⟧** - यह बाहरी ⟦1⟧ सीएलआई पर शेल करता है, जो सार्वजनिक arXiv/Crossref एपीआई के खिलाफ उद्धरण पहचानकर्ताओं को हल करता है (सत्यापित किए जा रहे उद्धरण आईडी/यूआरएल भेजता है)।
- **विशेषज्ञ स्तर** (⟦2⟧, पंजीकृत भूमिकाएँ) - यह ⟦4⟧ में आपके द्वारा कॉन्फ़िगर किए गए ⟦3⟧ को डिस्पैच प्रॉम्प्ट पोस्ट करता है (आमतौर पर एक स्थानीय मॉडल एंडपॉइंट)।
- **बजट / अनुरूपता परामर्श** (⟦5⟧ / ⟦6⟧) - यह एक सलाहकार निर्णय के लिए एक स्थानीय मॉडल को एचटीटीपी पर चरण/टूल-कॉल संदर्भ भेजता है।
ef16e6a5803e1c52.source:
- **⟦0⟧** — shells out to the external ⟦1⟧ CLI, which resolves citation identifiers against public arXiv/Crossref APIs (sends the citation IDs/URLs being verified).
- **Specialist tier** (⟦2⟧, registered roles) — POSTs dispatch prompts to the ⟦3⟧ you configure in ⟦4⟧ (typically a local model endpoint).
- **Budget / conformance consult** (⟦5⟧ / ⟦6⟧) — sends the step/tool-call context to a local model over HTTP for an advisory verdict.

94beabe80b410367.translation: तीनों डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से बंद हैं और स्थानीय नियतात्मक व्यवहार के लिए खुले रहते हैं। पूरी नीति के लिए [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) देखें।
94beabe80b410367.source: All three are off by default and fail open to local deterministic behavior. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for the full policy.

ab173d3d106024ec.translation: रेसिपी कार्ड, जूरी और पैक कैलिब्रेशन
ab173d3d106024ec.source: Recipe cards, the jury, and pack calibration

a4c80a9cac79d132.translation: एक प्रशिक्षित समीक्षक उतना ही अच्छा होता है जितना कि उसने जिस डेटा से सीखा है। रोल ओएस उस डेटा को एक रेसिपी कार्ड पर रिकॉर्ड करता है, समीक्षकों के एक पैनल को मापता है, और एक पूर्ण रन को पैक चयन को बढ़ावा देने देता है। इनमें से कोई भी मॉडल को नहीं बुलाता है। समान फ़ाइल और समान सीड समान संख्याएँ उत्पन्न करते हैं।
a4c80a9cac79d132.source: A trained critic is only as good as the data it learned from. Role OS records that data on a recipe card, measures a panel of critics, and lets a finished run boost pack choice. None of this calls a model. The same file and the same seed produce the same numbers.

7a6c19d45179ce42.translation: ⟦0⟧ एक कार्ड की जाँच करता है (⟦1⟧)। नौ मानक नियंत्रण प्रत्येक उस तरीके की रक्षा करते हैं जिससे एक समीक्षक अच्छा दिख सकता है, बिना अपने गुणों को सीखे। बिना माप के पास किया गया नियंत्रण एक अंतर है। एक असंगत माप एक त्रुटि है। ⟦2⟧ को विधि ⟦3⟧ का उपयोग करना होगा। ⟦4⟧: जब दोनों संपादन विधियों को रिकॉर्ड किया जाता है और उनके अंतराल ओवरलैप नहीं करते हैं, तो स्थिति ⟦5⟧ होनी चाहिए, या जाँच विफल हो जाती है। ⟦6⟧ केवल तभी पास होता है जब इसकी सटीकता का अंतराल पूरी तरह से 0.5 से ऊपर हो।
7a6c19d45179ce42.source: ⟦0⟧ checks a card (⟦1⟧). Nine standard controls each guard a way a critic can look good without having learned its attribute. A passed control with no measure is a gap. An inconsistent measure is an error. ⟦2⟧ has to use the method ⟦3⟧. ⟦4⟧: when both edit methods are recorded and their intervals don't overlap, the status must be ⟦5⟧, or the check fails. ⟦6⟧ passes only when its accuracy interval lies entirely above 0.5.

1980f1eb3dc9cdcb.translation: वह फ़ाइल एक भरी हुई सिंथेटिक कार्ड है, न कि एक प्रशिक्षित समीक्षक। जाँच प्रिंट करता है:
1980f1eb3dc9cdcb.source: That file is a filled synthetic card, not a trained critic. The check prints:

44618629d02bbf0a.translation: नोट एक तथ्य है, अंतर नहीं। ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ लेता है और कार्ड के आईडी और हैश को उस संस्करण पर पिन करता है। [हैंडबुक](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/recipe-cards/) देखें।
44618629d02bbf0a.source: The note is a fact, not a gap. ⟦0⟧ takes ⟦1⟧ and pins the card's id and hash on that version. See the [handbook](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/recipe-cards/).

0d47feaed31d4980.translation: ⟦0⟧ केवल तभी एक पैनल रखता है जब एक नेस्टेड समूह-क्लस्टर्ड अंतराल कहता है कि पैनल सर्वश्रेष्ठ एकल समीक्षक को हरा देता है। अन्यथा, निर्णय यह समीक्षक है, या ⟦1⟧ 30 आइटम या 10 समूहों से नीचे। एक समीक्षक जिसका कार्ड विफल या अनसुलझा मानक नियंत्रण है, उसे तब तक बाहर रखा जाता है जब तक कि ⟦2⟧ न हो। बिना कार्ड वाला समीक्षक अभी भी बैठा रहता है जब तक कि ⟦3⟧ न हो। स्कोर कभी भी उलट नहीं होते हैं। समान सीड समान संख्याएँ दोहराता है।
0d47feaed31d4980.source: ⟦0⟧ keeps a panel only when a nested group-clustered interval says the panel beats the best single critic. Otherwise the verdict is that critic, or ⟦1⟧ below 30 items or 10 groups. A critic whose card has a failed or unresolved standard control is left out unless ⟦2⟧. A critic with no card is still seated unless ⟦3⟧. Scores are never flipped. The same seed repeats the same numbers.

295dcee911f95728.translation: इस सिंथेटिक फ़ाइल पर निर्णय ⟦0⟧ है। इको और शार्प एक ही गलतियाँ करते हैं, इसलिए त्रुटि स्थिरता 1.0000 है और डुप्लिकेट फ़्लैग उन्हें नाम देते हैं। फ़्लैग किसी भी समीक्षक को नहीं हटाता है। नेस्टेड अंतराल [-0.1000, 0.0000] है। यह 0 को छूता है, इसलिए यह पूरी तरह से 0 से ऊपर नहीं है, और यहां तक कि --आउट के साथ भी यह कोई पैनल फ़ाइल नहीं लिखेगा, क्योंकि --आउट केवल एक पैनल निर्णय के लिए एक लिखता है। [हैंडबुक](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/jury/) में पूरी रिपोर्ट है।
295dcee911f95728.source: On this synthetic file the verdict is ⟦0⟧. echo and sharp make the same mistakes, so error consistency is 1.0000 and the duplicate flag names them. The flag does not drop either critic. The nested interval is [-0.1000, 0.0000]. It touches 0, so it does not lie entirely above 0, and even with --out it would write no panel file, because --out writes one only for a panel verdict. The [handbook](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/jury/) has the full report.

8d09b4bd029fa9d2.translation: जब एक रन समाप्त होता है, तो रोल ओएस एक परिणाम पंक्ति जोड़ता है। समान रन आईडी दूसरी पंक्ति नहीं लिखता है। एक पैक में कम से कम 5 रिकॉर्ड किए गए परिणाम होने के बाद, प्रत्येक पूर्ण रन जिसमें 0 सुधार हैं, उस पैक में +0.5 जोड़ता है, जिसकी अधिकतम सीमा +2 है। बढ़ावा कभी भी किसी ऐसे पैक को नाम नहीं देता है जिससे कीवर्ड पहले से मेल नहीं खाते थे। आत्मविश्वास 3 कीवर्ड हिट पर उच्च और 2 पर मध्यम रहता है, जो कीवर्ड स्कोर से लिया जाता है, न कि बढ़े हुए स्कोर से। रोल वेट नहीं बदलते हैं। आत्मविश्वास सीमाएँ नहीं बदलती हैं। कैलिब्रेशन रिपोर्ट कीवर्ड कटऑफ को देखने का सुझाव दे सकती है। रोल ओएस उस सुझाव को लागू नहीं करता है।
8d09b4bd029fa9d2.source: When a run ends, Role OS appends one outcome line. The same run id does not write a second line. After a pack has at least 5 recorded outcomes, each completed run with corrections 0 adds +0.5 to that pack, capped at +2. The boost never names a pack the keywords did not already match. Confidence stays high at 3 keyword hits and medium at 2, taken from the keyword score, not from the boosted score. Role weights do not change. Confidence thresholds do not change. The calibration report may suggest looking at the keyword cutoff. Role OS does not apply that suggestion.

d2a558ec2477f57b.translation: ⟦0⟧ बढ़ावा बंद कर देता है। रिकॉर्डिंग जारी रहती है।
d2a558ec2477f57b.source: ⟦0⟧ turns the boost off. Recording continues.

5d9a03ffb1e67dd3.translation: किसी भी परिणाम लेज़र के बिना एक निर्देशिका में, यह प्रिंट करता है:
5d9a03ffb1e67dd3.source: In a directory with no outcome ledger, that prints:

f96dc734fc56d305.translation: ⟦0⟧ और ⟦1⟧ बढ़ावा, रन गणना और स्वच्छ दर प्रिंट करते हैं जब लेज़र में वे होते हैं। [हैंडबुक](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/calibration/) देखें।
f96dc734fc56d305.source: ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ print the boost, the run count, and the clean rate when a ledger has them. See the [handbook](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/calibration/).

69c0375ce0b1bd96.translation: पैकेट सामग्री के विरुद्ध सभी 61 भूमिकाओं को मापता है, सिफारिशों की व्याख्या करता है, आत्मविश्वास का आकलन करता है
69c0375ce0b1bd96.source: Scores all 61 roles against packet content, explains recommendations, assesses confidence

9b5734a2ffde6c76.translation: स्कोर की गई भूमिकाओं, पैकेट-प्रकार पूर्वाग्रह से चरण-क्रमित श्रृंखलाओं को इकट्ठा करता है, टेम्पलेट-लॉक नहीं
9b5734a2ffde6c76.source: Assembles phase-ordered chains from scored roles, packet-type biased not template-locked

5f1de5dca184136a.translation: 4-पास सत्यापन: कठिन संघर्ष, अनुक्रम, अतिरेक, कवरेज अंतर। मरम्मत सुझाव।
5f1de5dca184136a.source: 4-pass validation: hard conflicts, sequence, redundancy, coverage gaps. Repair suggestions.

0258dec72c1d04cb.translation: स्वचालित रूप से अवरुद्ध/अस्वीकृत/विभाजित कार्य को कारण + आवश्यक कलाकृति के साथ सही समाधानकर्ता तक पहुंचाता है
0258dec72c1d04cb.source: Auto-routes blocked/rejected/split work to the right resolver with reason + required artifact

a30c19c9c1d73bce.translation: भूमिका-जागरूक संरचित साक्ष्य निर्णयों में। पर्याप्तता जाँच। 12 साक्ष्य प्रकार।
a30c19c9c1d73bce.source: Role-aware structured evidence in verdicts. Sufficiency checks. 12 evidence kinds.

66ca2fbc74192a56.translation: कोडिंग-एजेंट हार्नेस के लिए निष्पादन मेनिफेस्ट उत्पन्न करता है। प्रति-भूमिका उपकरण प्रोफाइल, सिस्टम संकेत, बजट।
66ca2fbc74192a56.source: Generates execution manifests for the coding-agent harness. Per-role tool profiles, system prompts, budgets.

189837510590109e.translation: पूरी सूची सिद्ध: 30/30 गोल्ड-टास्क + 5/5 नकारात्मक परीक्षण। 7 पैक परीक्षण पूर्ण।
189837510590109e.source: Full roster proven: 30/30 gold-task + 5/5 negative trials. 7 pack trials complete.

d861691ab1c076d4.translation: 10 कैलिब्रेटेड पैक जिसमें ऑटो-चयन, बेमेल गार्ड और मुफ्त-राउटिंग फॉलबैक है।
d861691ab1c076d4.source: 10 calibrated packs with auto-selection, mismatch guards, and free-routing fallback.

4c8fc4ef1b991050.translation: एक प्रशिक्षित भूमिका की डेटा रेसिपी। नौ मानक नियंत्रण, प्रत्येक पास किए गए नियंत्रण पर एक माप, और एक विहित हैश।
4c8fc4ef1b991050.source: A trained role's data recipe. Nine standard controls, a measure on each passed control, and a canonical hash.

266735845bc3b322.translation: प्रशिक्षित समीक्षकों को मापता है। केवल तभी एक पैनल रखता है जब यह होल्ड-आउट समूहों पर सर्वश्रेष्ठ एकल समीक्षक को हरा देता है। विफल या अनसुलझा रेसिपी नियंत्रण एक समीक्षक को बाहर कर देता है।
266735845bc3b322.source: Measures trained critics. Keeps a panel only when it beats the best single critic on held-out groups. Failed or unresolved recipe controls leave a critic out.

80c86c7912e33560.translation: जब एक रन समाप्त होता है तो एक परिणाम रिकॉर्ड करता है। 5 परिणामों के बाद, एक स्वच्छ पूर्णता एक पैक को बढ़ावा देती है जिससे कीवर्ड पहले से मेल खाते थे (+0.5 प्रत्येक, अधिकतम +2)। आत्मविश्वास अभी भी कीवर्ड स्कोर से आता है। रोल वेट और आत्मविश्वास सीमाएँ नहीं बदलती हैं।
80c86c7912e33560.source: Records one outcome when a run ends. After 5 outcomes, a clean completion boosts a pack the keywords already matched (+0.5 each, cap +2). Confidence still comes from the keyword score. Role weights and confidence thresholds do not change.

89a584bfbaaba524.translation: समग्र कार्य का पता लगाता है, इसे चाइल्ड पैकेट में विभाजित करता है, पैकेट असाइन करता है, निर्भरताएँ बनाए रखता है।
89a584bfbaaba524.source: Detects composite work, splits into child packets, assigns packs, preserves dependencies.

aee2c0a9445b45b7.translation: कलाकृति पासिंग, शाखा रिकवरी और संश्लेषण के साथ निर्भरता क्रम में चाइल्ड पैकेट चलाता है।
aee2c0a9445b45b7.source: Runs child packets in dependency order with artifact passing, branch recovery, and synthesis.

14817acf6866a093.translation: मध्य-रन स्कोप परिवर्तन, निष्कर्ष, या नई आवश्यकताएँ योजना को पुनरारंभ किए बिना अपडेट करती हैं।
14817acf6866a093.source: Mid-run scope changes, findings, or new requirements update the plan without restarting.

ca7002705053af07.translation: ⟦0⟧ CLAUDE.md, /roleos-route, /roleos-review, /roleos-status को स्केफोल्ड करता है। ⟦1⟧ वायरिंग को सत्यापित करता है। रूट कार्ड जुड़ाव साबित करते हैं।
ca7002705053af07.source: ⟦0⟧ scaffolds CLAUDE.md, /roleos-route, /roleos-review, /roleos-status. ⟦1⟧ verifies wiring. Route cards prove engagement.

52ecba60b2c61e38.translation: 5 जीवनचक्र हुक (SessionStart, PromptSubmit, PreToolUse, SubagentStart, Stop)। सलाहकार प्रवर्तन: रूट कार्ड अनुस्मारक, राइट-टूल गेटिंग, सबएजेंट भूमिका इंजेक्शन, पूर्णता ऑडिट।
52ecba60b2c61e38.source: 5 lifecycle hooks (SessionStart, PromptSubmit, PreToolUse, SubagentStart, Stop). Advisory enforcement: route card reminders, write-tool gating, subagent role injection, completion audit.

d4da27b01a80220d.translation: प्रति-भूमिका कलाकृति अनुबंध। पैक हैंडऑफ़ अनुबंध। संरचनात्मक सत्यापन। श्रृंखला पूर्णता जाँच। डाउनस्ट्रीम भूमिकाएँ कभी भी यह अनुमान नहीं लगाती हैं कि उन्हें क्या प्राप्त हुआ।
d4da27b01a80220d.source: Per-role artifact contracts. Pack handoff contracts. Structural validation. Chain completeness checks. Downstream roles never guess what they received.

25b0b29e9ff76b2b.translation: 9 नामित मिशन (feature-ship, bugfix, treatment, docs-release, security-hardening, research-launch, brainstorm, deep-audit, dogfood-swarm)। प्रत्येक पैक, भूमिका श्रृंखला, कलाकृति प्रवाह, वृद्धि शाखाओं, ईमानदार-आंशिक परिभाषा की घोषणा करता है।
25b0b29e9ff76b2b.source: 9 named missions (feature-ship, bugfix, treatment, docs-release, security-hardening, research-launch, brainstorm, deep-audit, dogfood-swarm). Each declares pack, role chain, artifact flow, escalation branches, honest-partial definition.

3c24333c97ebfef0.translation: रन बनाएं, ट्रैक किए गए स्टेट के साथ स्टेप-बाय-स्टेप आगे बढ़ें, ईमानदार रिपोर्टिंग के साथ पूरा करें/असफल करें। ब्लॉक किए गए स्टेप का प्रसार, चेन से बाहर होने पर चेतावनी, अंतिम स्टेप को फिर से खोलना।
3c24333c97ebfef0.source: Create runs, step through with tracked state, complete/fail with honest reporting. Blocked-step propagation, out-of-chain escalation warnings, last-step re-opening.

ea43c27eb47b51df.translation: ⟦0⟧ स्वचालित रूप से मिशन बनाम पैक बनाम फ्री रूटिंग का निर्धारण करता है। आत्मविश्वास स्कोर, विकल्प और समग्र पहचान के साथ फॉलबैक लैडर।
ea43c27eb47b51df.source: ⟦0⟧ decides mission vs pack vs free routing automatically. Fallback ladder with confidence scores, alternatives, and composite detection.

bc2ee988ca971964.translation: ⟦0⟧ डिस्क-आधारित रन बनाता है। ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧। हस्तक्षेप: रूट बदलें, बढ़ाएं, पुनः प्रयास करें, ब्लॉक करें, फिर से खोलें। स्टेप-लोकल मार्गदर्शन। घर्षण माप।
bc2ee988ca971964.source: ⟦0⟧ creates disk-backed runs. ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧. Interventions: reroute, escalate, retry, block, reopen. Step-local guidance. Friction measurement.

7c8b12c9959386ca.translation: दो-स्तरीय आर्किटेक्चर: सत्य (रोल-नेटिव स्कीमा, उत्पत्ति परमाणु, क्रॉस-परीक्षा विवाद ग्राफ) + रेंडर (5 अलग-अलग आवाजें, शाब्दिक प्रतिबंध, बहस प्रतिलेख)। ट्रेस लिंक साबित करते हैं कि रेंडर किए गए प्रत्येक दावे का संबंध सत्य परमाणु से है। गोल्डन रन सिद्ध।
7c8b12c9959386ca.source: Two-layer architecture: truth (role-native schemas, provenance atoms, cross-exam dispute graph) + render (5 distinct voices, lexical bans, debate transcript). Trace links prove every rendered claim maps to a truth atom. Golden run proven.

85532740b5cf28d9.translation: मैनिफेस्ट-स्केल्ड रिपो ऑडिट: रिपो को घटकों में विघटित करें, N ऑडिटर + M टेस्ट ट्रुथ ऑडिटर + K सीम ऑडिटर को निर्भरता ग्राफ से भेजें, रैंक किए गए निष्कर्ष और कार्य योजना में संश्लेषित करें। गतिशील वितरण रिपो आकार के साथ स्केल करता है (2N + K + 3 सूत्र)। हर स्टेप पर कलाकृति सत्यापन के साथ रनर-नेटिव।
85532740b5cf28d9.source: Manifest-scaled repo audit: decompose repo into components, dispatch N auditors + M test truth auditors + K seam auditors from dependency graph, synthesize into ranked verdict and action plan. Dynamic dispatch scales with repo size (2N + K + 3 formula). Runner-native with artifact validation at every step.

b590ab7a86040f8d.translation: मल्टी-पास कन्वर्जेंस: तीन स्वास्थ्य चरण (बग/सुरक्षा → सक्रिय → मानवीकरण) फिर फीचर पास। विशेष फ़ाइल स्वामित्व, प्रत्येक चरण के बाद बिल्ड गेट, उपयोगकर्ता चेकपॉइंट। डोमेन ऑटो-डिटेक्शन मैनिफेस्ट उत्पन्न करता है। डॉगफूड-लैब्स के लिए साक्ष्य पुल।
b590ab7a86040f8d.source: Multi-pass convergence: three health stages (bug/security → proactive → humanization) then feature pass. Exclusive file ownership, build gates after every wave, user checkpoints. Domain auto-detection generates manifests. Evidence bridge to dogfood-labs.

956453d14fc3322b.translation: पूर्ण फ़ीचर डिलीवरी: दायरा → विशिष्टता → कार्यान्वयन → परीक्षण → समीक्षा
956453d14fc3322b.source: Full feature delivery: scope → spec → implement → test → review

6741deef211133d9.translation: मूल कारण का निदान करें, ठीक करें, परीक्षण करें, सत्यापित करें
6741deef211133d9.source: Diagnose root cause, fix, test, verify

7679fc29a6879384.translation: शिपचेक + पॉलिश + दस्तावेज़ + सीआई सत्यापित करें + समीक्षा करें
7679fc29a6879384.source: Shipcheck + polish + docs + CI verify + review

e8bb2ab16135273f.translation: खतरा मॉडल, ऑडिट, कमजोरियों को ठीक करें, पुन: ऑडिट, सत्यापित करें
e8bb2ab16135273f.source: Threat model, audit, fix vulnerabilities, re-audit, verify

759fa61f122ae9a3.translation: प्रश्न तैयार करें, अनुसंधान करें, निष्कर्षों का दस्तावेजीकरण करें, निर्णय लें
759fa61f122ae9a3.source: Frame question, research, document findings, decide

e1129f1bb60bbd29.translation: ट्रैक किए जा सकने वाले असहमति और निष्कर्ष के साथ संरचित बहु-दृष्टिकोण पूछताछ
e1129f1bb60bbd29.source: Structured multi-perspective inquiry with traceable disagreement and verdict

32c34fa9d56cd671.translation: मैनिफेस्ट-समर्थित रिपो ऑडिट - गतिशील वितरण के माध्यम से रिपो ग्राफ के साथ कार्यकर्ता गणना स्केल करता है
32c34fa9d56cd671.source: Manifest-backed repo audit — worker count scales with repo graph via dynamic dispatch

37515bf9473c7200.translation: मल्टी-पास कन्वर्जेंस: स्वास्थ्य-ए → स्वास्थ्य-बी → स्वास्थ्य-सी → फ़ीचर → अंतिम संश्लेषण
37515bf9473c7200.source: Multi-pass convergence: health-a → health-b → health-c → feature → final synthesis

7c9a2aefcc5fddb1.translation: प्रत्येक मिशन में ईमानदार-आंशिक परिभाषाएँ शामिल हैं - जब काम रुक जाता है, तो सिस्टम दस्तावेज़ करता है कि क्या पूरा किया गया था और क्या शेष है, बजाय इसके कि पूरा होने का दिखावा किया जाए।
7c9a2aefcc5fddb1.source: Each mission includes honest-partial definitions — when work stalls, the system documents what was completed and what remains instead of bluffing completion.

ea694c17599cf6df.translation: यह "एआई विचार मंथन" नहीं है। विचार मंथन मिशन **कानून के तहत विशेष भूमिकाएँ हैं, जिसमें ट्रैक किए जा सकने वाली असहमति और निष्कर्ष देने वाला आउटपुट होता है।**
ea694c17599cf6df.source: Not "AI brainstorming." The brainstorm mission is **specialized roles under law, with traceable disagreement and verdict-bearing output.**

27775fe5ae9bd503.translation: - **लेयर 1 (सत्य):** चार विश्लेषक रोल-नेटिव स्कीमा (कॉन्टेक्स्टमैप, यूजरवैल्यूमैप, मैकेनिक्समैप, पोजिशनिंगमैप) उत्सर्जित करते हैं - साझा गद्य नहीं। प्रत्येक भूमिका ब्लाइंडस्पॉट-प्रवर्तित है: निषिद्ध वाक्यांश, निषिद्ध दावा प्रकार, फ़िल्टर्ड इनपुट विभाजन। परमाणुओं में उत्पत्ति होती है। एक निर्देशित क्रॉस-परीक्षा ग्राफ लक्षित चुनौतियाँ उत्पन्न करता है। मूल विश्लेषक दबाव में बचाव, संकुचित या वापस लेते हैं।
27775fe5ae9bd503.source: - **Layer 1 (truth):** Four analysts emit role-native schemas (ContextMap, UserValueMap, MechanicsMap, PositioningMap) — not shared prose. Each role is blindspot-enforced: forbidden phrases, forbidden claim kinds, filtered input partitions. Atoms carry provenance. A directed cross-examination graph produces targeted challenges. Original analysts defend, narrow, or retract under pressure.

01fece22cede08ee.translation: - **लेयर 2 (रेंडर):** पांच अलग-अलग मानव आवाजें (बाउंड्री मेमो, फील्ड नोट्स, सिस्टम स्केच, दावा संक्षिप्त, क्रॉस-परीक्षा प्रतिलेख) शाब्दिक प्रतिबंधों के साथ जो आवाज अभिसरण को रोकते हैं। संश्लेषण सत्य का उपभोग करता है, कभी भी रेंडर किए गए गद्य का नहीं। दोनों परतें हमेशा उपलब्ध होती हैं।
01fece22cede08ee.source: - **Layer 2 (render):** Five distinct human voices (Boundary Memo, Field Notes, System Sketch, Claim Brief, Cross-Exam Transcript) with lexical bans preventing voice convergence. Synthesis consumes truth, never rendered prose. Both layers always available.

a768e7d969a2efe7.translation: - **कस्टडी की श्रृंखला:** रेंडर किए गए प्रत्येक वाक्य का पता सत्य-परत परमाणु तक लगाया जा सकता है। संश्लेषण दिशाएँ परमाणुओं का हवाला देती हैं। क्रॉस-परीक्षा वास्तविक दावा आईडी को लक्षित करता है। विवाद ग्राफ उत्पाद है, गद्य नहीं।
a768e7d969a2efe7.source: - **Chain of custody:** Every rendered sentence traces back to a truth-layer atom. Synthesis directions cite atoms. Cross-exam targets real claim IDs. The dispute graph is the product, not the prose.

237f7a8cce0edf16.translation: **सिद्ध:** v0.4 गोल्डन रन - कस्टडी की पूरी श्रृंखला सत्यापित। पूर्ण कलाकृति श्रृंखला के लिए [⟦0⟧](examples/golden-run.md) देखें।
237f7a8cce0edf16.source: **Proven:** v0.4 golden run — full chain of custody verified. See [⟦0⟧](examples/golden-run.md) for the complete artifact chain.

a9d0e781c4be0b35.translation: यह एक सतही स्कैन नहीं है। गहन ऑडिट मिशन **एक रिपो को बाध्य घटकों में विघटित करता है और रिपो के अपने निर्भरता ग्राफ द्वारा निर्धारित पैमाने पर विशेषज्ञ ऑडिटर भेजता है।**
a9d0e781c4be0b35.source: Not a surface scan. The deep audit mission **decomposes a repo into bounded components and dispatches specialist auditors at a scale determined by the repo's own dependency graph.**

b81a8695e1d02bcb.translation:
- **गतिशील वितरण** - कार्यकर्ता गणना निश्चित नहीं है। 10-घटक रिपो जिसमें 5 सीमा क्लस्टर हैं, 28 चरण उत्पन्न करते हैं (2×10 + 5 + 3)। 3-घटक रिपो 12 उत्पन्न करता है। स्केलिंग सूत्र ⟦0⟧ है जहाँ N = घटक, K = सीमाएँ।
- **मैनिफेस्ट-समर्थित पार्सल** - एक ⟦1⟧ घटकों (फ़ाइल पथ, पंक्ति गणना, विवरण के साथ) और सीमाओं (इंटरफ़ेस विवरण के साथ/से) को परिभाषित करता है। प्रत्येक ऑडिटर को केवल अपना पार्सल प्राप्त होता है।
- **चार भूमिका प्रोटोटाइप** - घटक ऑडिटर (प्रति मॉड्यूल कोड सत्य), टेस्ट ट्रुथ ऑडिटर (जो परीक्षण सिद्ध करते हैं बनाम जो मौजूद हैं), सीम ऑडिटर (निर्भरता ग्राफ से एकीकरण सीमाएँ), ऑडिट सिंथेसाइज़र (सभी पार्सल से रैंक किया गया निष्कर्ष + कार्य योजना)।
- **प्रत्येक चरण पर कलाकृति सत्यापन** - ⟦2⟧ दोनों निष्पादन पथों में प्रत्येक चरण के पूरा होने पर सक्रिय होता है। परिणाम चरण वस्तुओं से जुड़े होते हैं। सिस्टम जानता है कि प्रत्येक कलाकृति ने अपने अनुबंध को पूरा किया या नहीं।
- **ईमानदार आंशिक** - जब बजट या दायरा पूरा होने को रोकता है, तो प्रति-घटक निष्कर्ष व्यक्तिगत रूप से मान्य होते हैं। सिस्टम जो कुछ भी पूरा किया गया है, उससे संश्लेषित करता है, कभी भी पूर्ण कवरेज का दिखावा नहीं करता है।
b81a8695e1d02bcb.source:
- **Dynamic dispatch** — worker count is not fixed. A 10-component repo with 5 boundary clusters produces 28 steps (2×10 + 5 + 3). A 3-component repo produces 12. The scaling formula is ⟦0⟧ where N = components, K = boundaries.
- **Manifest-backed parcels** — an ⟦1⟧ defines components (with file paths, line counts, descriptions) and boundaries (from/to with interface descriptions). Each auditor receives only its parcel.
- **Four role archetypes** — Component Auditor (code truth per module), Test Truth Auditor (tests that prove vs tests that exist), Seam Auditor (integration boundaries from the dependency graph), Audit Synthesizer (ranked verdict + action plan from all parcels).
- **Artifact validation at every step** — ⟦2⟧ fires on every step completion in both execution paths. Results attached to step objects. The system knows whether each artifact met its contract.
- **Honest partial** — when budget or scope blocks completion, per-component findings are individually valid. The system synthesizes from whatever completed, never bluffs full coverage.

18a325ec2e04f585.translation: **सिद्ध:** रनर-नेटिव प्रूफ रन - वास्तविक मैनिफेस्ट के खिलाफ 18 परीक्षण, एस्केलेशन री-ओपनिंग और आंशिक विफलता सहित पूर्ण जीवनचक्र सत्यापित। 3/6/10/15-घटक मैनिफेस्ट के लिए स्केलिंग सूत्र सत्यापित।
18a325ec2e04f585.source: **Proven:** Runner-native proof run — 18 tests against real manifest, full lifecycle verified including escalation re-opening and partial failure. Scaling formula verified for 3/6/10/15-component manifests.

e07d3d407008d4f5.translation: यह एक-पास लिनटर नहीं है। डॉगफूड झुंड मिशन **एक मल्टी-पास कन्वर्जेंस प्रोटोकॉल चलाता है जो एक रिपो को तीन स्वास्थ्य चरणों और पुनरावृत्त फ़ीचर डिलीवरी के माध्यम से "काम करता है" से "उत्पादन-तैयार" तक ले जाता है।**
e07d3d407008d4f5.source: Not a one-pass linter. The dogfood swarm mission **runs a multi-pass convergence protocol that moves a repo from "works" to "production-ready" through three health stages and iterative feature delivery.**

20c8f474dd03dc61.translation:
- **तीन-चरणीय स्वास्थ्य जांच** — चरण ए में बग और सुरक्षा संबंधी समस्याओं को ठीक किया जाता है (जब तक 0 गंभीर + 0 उच्च प्राथमिकता वाली समस्याएं हल न हो जाएं)। चरण बी में सक्रिय रूप से सुरक्षा को मजबूत किया जाता है (उपयोगकर्ता निष्कर्षों की समीक्षा करते हैं)। चरण सी में कोडबेस को उपयोगकर्ता के अनुकूल बनाया जाता है — त्रुटि संदेश जो उपयोगकर्ताओं की मदद करते हैं, पुन: कनेक्शन प्रतिक्रिया, लोडिंग स्थिति, पहुंच क्षमता। प्रत्येक चरण एक अलग दृष्टिकोण है, यह एक ही स्कैन को दोहराने जैसा नहीं है।
- **विशिष्ट फ़ाइल स्वामित्व** — प्रत्येक डोमेन एजेंट ⟦0⟧ के माध्यम से विशिष्ट फ़ाइलों का मालिक होता है। कोई भी दो एजेंट एक ही फ़ाइल को संपादित नहीं करते हैं। कोई विलय संघर्ष नहीं। कोई समन्वय संबंधी अतिरिक्त बोझ नहीं।
- **बिल्ड गेट** — प्रत्येक चरण के बाद लिंट, टाइपचेक और परीक्षण सफल होना चाहिए। सिस्टम स्वचालित रूप से बिल्ड सिस्टम (नोड, रस्ट, पायथन, गो) का पता लगाता है और सही कमांड चलाता है।
- **उपयोगकर्ता जांच बिंदु** — स्वास्थ्य-बी और सुविधा जांच के लिए निष्पादन से पहले स्पष्ट उपयोगकर्ता अनुमोदन की आवश्यकता होती है। सिस्टम निष्कर्ष प्रस्तुत करता है, और उपयोगकर्ता यह तय करता है कि क्या बनाना है।
- **पुनरावृत्तीय अभिसरण** — चरण तब तक दोहराए जाते हैं जब तक कि निकास शर्तें पूरी नहीं हो जातीं या अधिकतम पुनरावृत्तियों की संख्या तक नहीं पहुंच जाती। प्रत्येक चरण पिछली त्रुटियों के कारण होने वाली समस्याओं को पकड़ने के लिए शुरुआत से फिर से ऑडिट करता है।
- **डोमेन स्वचालित पहचान** — ⟦1⟧ रिपॉजिटरी प्रकार (सीएलआई, वेब, डेस्कटॉप, एमसीपी, मोनोरेपो) का पता लगाता है और गैर-अतिव्यापी डोमेन असाइनमेंट उत्पन्न करता है।
20c8f474dd03dc61.source:
- **Three-stage health pass** — Stage A fixes bugs and security issues (loop until 0 CRITICAL + 0 HIGH). Stage B applies proactive hardening (user reviews findings). Stage C humanizes the codebase — error messages that help users, reconnection feedback, loading states, accessibility. Each stage is a distinct lens, not the same scan repeated.
- **Exclusive file ownership** — every domain agent owns specific files via ⟦0⟧. No two agents edit the same file. No merge conflicts. No coordination overhead.
- **Build gates** — lint + typecheck + test must pass after every wave. The system auto-detects the build system (Node, Rust, Python, Go) and runs the right commands.
- **User checkpoints** — Health-B and the feature pass require explicit user approval before execution. The system presents findings, the user decides what to build.
- **Iterative convergence** — stages loop with wave loops until exit conditions are met or max iterations reached. Each wave re-audits from scratch to catch regressions introduced by previous fixes.
- **Domain auto-detection** — ⟦1⟧ detects repo type (CLI, web, desktop, MCP, monorepo) and generates non-overlapping domain assignments.

15a44ea83e9a46a2.translation: **सिद्ध:** claude-collaborate (2026-03-28) — 35→129 परीक्षण, 106 स्वास्थ्य संबंधी समस्याओं का समाधान, v1.1.0 जारी। 9 चरणों वाला प्रोटोकॉल v2.0।
15a44ea83e9a46a2.source: **Proven:** claude-collaborate (2026-03-28) — 35→129 tests, 106 health findings fixed, v1.1.0 shipped. Protocol v2.0 with 9 phases.

cf84f90f6340dc9d.translation: Un livello operativo nativo per repository che gestisce, indirizza, convalida ed esegue il lavoro degli agenti di codifica attraverso 61 contratti di ruolo specializzati. Crea pacchetti di attività, assembla il team giusto in base a una valutazione dei ruoli, rileva eventuali problemi prima dell'esecuzione, indirizza automaticamente il recupero quando il lavoro viene bloccato o rifiutato e richiede prove strutturate in ogni valutazione. Include la distribuzione dinamica per missioni su larga scala: un repository con 10 componenti diventa automaticamente un processo di audit con 28 passaggi, anziché 6.
cf84f90f6340dc9d.source: A repo-native operating layer that staffs, routes, validates, and runs coding-agent work through 61 specialized role contracts. Creates task packets, assembles the right team from scored role matching, detects broken chains before execution, auto-routes recovery when work is blocked or rejected, and requires structured evidence in every verdict. Includes dynamic dispatch for manifest-scaled missions — a 10-component repo automatically becomes 28 auditor steps, not 6.

e020c5b61b4c5516.translation: L'adattatore Claude Code è disponibile (⟦0⟧ fornisce gli schemi ⟦1⟧). I contratti sono in formato markdown, quindi possono essere utilizzati da qualsiasi framework di codifica. Questo repository non afferma che un secondo adattatore sia già in esecuzione.
e020c5b61b4c5516.source: Claude Code adapter ships (⟦0⟧ scaffolds ⟦1⟧). The contracts are markdown any coding harness can consume — this repo does not claim a second adapter already runs.

2fecfb0adb537c06.translation: Role OS è il modo professionale per gestire il lavoro degli agenti di codifica. Previene i problemi specifici che i flussi di lavoro AI generici causano:
2fecfb0adb537c06.source: Role OS is the professional way to staff coding-agent work. It prevents the specific failures that generic AI workflows produce:

b4394a9faee1fdd0.translation:
- **Deriva:** i ruoli mantengono la loro area di competenza. Il prodotto non viene riprogettato. Il frontend non ridefinisce l'ambito. Il backend non inventa la direzione del prodotto.
- **Completamento errato:** la definizione di "completato" è precisa. Il lavoro che nasconde lacune, omette la verifica o risolve un problema diverso viene rifiutato.
- **Contaminazione:** i progetti derivati o ereditati conservano residui di identità. Role OS rileva e rifiuta la deriva tra progetti in termini di terminologia, elementi visivi e modelli mentali.
- **Progressi basati sulle sensazioni:** ogni passaggio è strutturato. Ogni valutazione è collegata a prove. "Sembra completato" non è uno stato valido.
b4394a9faee1fdd0.source:
- **Drift** — roles stay in lane. Product doesn't redesign. Frontend doesn't redefine scope. Backend doesn't invent product direction.
- **False completion** — the done definition is concrete. Work that hides gaps, skips verification, or solves a different problem gets rejected.
- **Contamination** — forked or inherited projects carry identity residue. Role OS detects and rejects cross-project drift in terminology, visuals, and mental models.
- **Vibes-based progress** — every handoff is structured. Every verdict ties to evidence. "It feels done" is not a valid state.

24000d080008eb71.translation: Descrivi la tua attività. Role OS determina automaticamente il livello di orchestrazione appropriato.
24000d080008eb71.source: Describe your task. Role OS decides the right level of orchestration automatically.

1c100b368e60d4cd.translation:
1. **Missione:** quando l'attività corrisponde a un flusso di lavoro ricorrente comprovato (correzione di bug, trattamento, rilascio di funzionalità, documentazione, sicurezza, ricerca, brainstorming, audit approfondito, test su un gruppo ristretto). Catena di ruoli nota, flusso di artefatti, rami di escalation e definizioni parziali oneste.
2. **Pacchetto:** quando l'attività appartiene a una famiglia nota, ma non ha la forma completa di una missione. 10 pacchetti di team calibrati con selezione automatica e protezioni contro le incongruenze.
3. **Instradamento libero:** quando l'attività è nuova, mista o incerta. Valuta tutti i 61 ruoli in base al contenuto del pacchetto e assembla una catena dinamica.
1c100b368e60d4cd.source:
1. **Mission** — when the task matches a proven recurring workflow (bugfix, treatment, feature-ship, docs, security, research, brainstorm, deep-audit, dogfood-swarm). Known role chain, artifact flow, escalation branches, and honest-partial definitions.
2. **Pack** — when the task is a known family but not a full mission shape. 10 calibrated team packs with auto-selection and mismatch guards.
3. **Free routing** — when the task is novel, mixed, or uncertain. Scores all 61 roles against packet content and assembles a dynamic chain.

75f8873ba74e05a0.translation: Il sistema non forza mai il lavoro attraverso un'astrazione errata. Spiega perché ha scelto ogni livello e offre alternative.
75f8873ba74e05a0.source: The system never forces work through the wrong abstraction. It explains why it chose each level and offers alternatives.

48c5dfa2c6700aad.translation: Le esecuzioni vengono salvate su disco (⟦0⟧), quindi le sessioni interrotte riprendono senza problemi. Ogni passaggio include indicazioni per l'operatore: cosa produrre, sezioni richieste e condizioni di arresto.
48c5dfa2c6700aad.source: Runs persist to disk (⟦0⟧), so interrupted sessions resume cleanly. Every step includes operator guidance: what to produce, required sections, and stop conditions.

42567567674fea71.translation:
1. **Ogni ruolo produce un passaggio:** output strutturato con elementi di prova che riducono l'ambiguità per il ruolo successivo.
2. **La revisione critica viene eseguita in base al contratto:** accetta, rifiuta o blocca in base a prove strutturate, non a impressioni.
3. **L'instradamento di recupero avviene automaticamente:** il lavoro bloccato o rifiutato viene indirizzato al risolutore corretto con una motivazione, un tipo di recupero e l'artefatto richiesto.
42567567674fea71.source:
1. **Each role produces a handoff** — structured output with evidence items that reduce ambiguity for the next role
2. **Critic reviews against contract** — accepts, rejects, or blocks based on structured evidence, not impression
3. **Recovery routes automatically** — blocked or rejected work gets routed to the right resolver with a reason, recovery type, and required artifact

4aa0d18ae81600b2.translation: Role OS può consultare un **analista del budget dei token** locale per ogni passaggio di distribuzione e allegare una previsione di spesa consultiva al manifesto: facoltativa (⟦0⟧), consultiva (non blocca mai una distribuzione) e con fallback a una base deterministica. Disattivata per impostazione predefinita; la previsione è locale e gratuita. Consulta il [manuale](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/specialist-budget/).
4aa0d18ae81600b2.source: Role OS can consult a local **Token Budget Analyst** for each dispatch step and attach an advisory spend forecast to the manifest — opt-in (⟦0⟧), advisory (it never blocks a dispatch), and fail-open to a deterministic baseline. Off by default; the forecast is local and free to run. See the [handbook](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/specialist-budget/).

029f61d58f017a61.translation: Role OS verifica e controlla le chiamate agli strumenti al confine ⟦0⟧: in modo deterministico, senza modelli attivi:
029f61d58f017a61.source: Role OS verifies and gates tool calls at the ⟦0⟧ seam — deterministically, with no model on the hot path:

363e3d87e3acda4a.translation:
- **Monitoraggio della conformità** (consultivo, con fallback) — uno schema deterministico + un limite di contratto computabile verifica una chiamata proposta rispetto al suo catalogo di contratti di strumenti e allega una valutazione consultiva su una chiamata *comprovatamente* non conforme; non blocca mai. Un limite LLM facoltativo (⟦0⟧) gestisce i residui genuinamente semantici.
- **Controllo delle capacità** (blocco, facoltativo ⟦1⟧, disattivato per impostazione predefinita) — autorizzazione minima deterministica su azioni *irreversibili* (pubblicazione su npm/PyPI, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, modifiche al repository, distribuzione su Pages). Un'azione controllata viene negata a meno che il direttore non abbia concesso la sua capacità in ⟦4⟧, quindi un passaggio errato (un errore onesto o uno iniettato) non può attivare un'azione irreversibile non autorizzata. Il complemento preventivo alla regola del compensatore denominato. Consulta il [manuale](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/).
363e3d87e3acda4a.source:
- **Conformance watcher** (advisory, fail-open) — a deterministic schema + computable-contract floor checks a proposed call against its catalogued tool-contract and attaches an advisory verdict on a *proven* nonconformant call; it never blocks. An opt-in LLM ceiling (⟦0⟧) handles the genuinely-semantic residue.
- **Capability gate** (fail-closed, opt-in ⟦1⟧, default OFF) — deterministic least-privilege on *irreversible* actions (npm/PyPI publish, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, repo edits, Pages deploy). A gated action is denied unless the director granted its capability in ⟦4⟧, so a wrong step — an honest mistake or an injected one — can't trigger an unauthorized irreversible action. The preventive complement to the named-compensator rule. See the [handbook](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/).

25ab8427ec35959d.translation: Ogni ruolo ha un **dossier**: una scheda del personaggio che funge anche da configurazione in fase di esecuzione. Sei attitudini (Rigore, Ritmo, Portata, Scetticismo, Autonomia, Candore) corrispondono a controlli di distribuzione reali; uno strato di **disposizione** con otto archetipi (Scettico, Costruttore, Investigatore, Innovatore...) contiene un'istruzione comportamentale; e ogni ruolo ha un ritratto e una valutazione. Esplora l'intero equipaggio come una galleria (⟦0⟧): il radar di ogni ruolo mostra la sua configurazione ottimizzata rispetto al suo ideale canonico.
25ab8427ec35959d.source: Every role has a **dossier** — a character sheet that doubles as run-time config. Six aptitudes (Rigor, Pace, Range, Skepticism, Autonomy, Candor) map to real dispatch knobs; an eight-archetype **disposition** layer (Skeptic, Builder, Investigator, Maverick…) carries a behavioral instruction; and each role has a painted portrait and a grade. Browse the whole crew as a gallery (⟦0⟧) — each role's radar shows its tuned build against its canonical ideal.

3d826e11ff50b104.translation: Quando un ruolo ha un dossier, la distribuzione inietta una **postura operativa**: l'istruzione comportamentale della disposizione più una linea di postura dalle attitudini del ruolo, quindi la scheda configura effettivamente il ruolo. Facoltativa e additiva: i ruoli senza un dossier si comportano esattamente come prima. Consulta il [manuale](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/crew-dossier/).
3d826e11ff50b104.source: When a role has a dossier, dispatch injects an **Operating Posture** — the disposition's behavioral instruction plus a posture line from the role's aptitudes — so the sheet actually configures the role. Opt-in and additive: roles without a dossier behave exactly as before. See the [handbook](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/crew-dossier/).

7437e0e2d350a551.translation: Lo stato di implementazione a livello di organizzazione (coda, decisioni, registri di audit, pacchetti di blocco per repository) si trova in un repository **privato**, interno all'organizzazione (⟦0⟧). Questo repository è il prodotto; quell'altro repository è lo stato operativo.
7437e0e2d350a551.source: Org-wide rollout state (queue, decisions, audit records, per-repo lock packets) lives in a separate **private**, org-internal repo (⟦0⟧). This repo is the product; that repo is operational state.

313a71a9f314ec91.translation: Role OS non possiede né duplica il livello di memoria. Quando esiste un archivio di memoria del progetto, è il sistema di continuità canonico: i fatti del repository, le decisioni, i problemi aperti e la cronologia del trattamento sono archiviati lì.
313a71a9f314ec91.source: Role OS does not own or duplicate the memory layer. Where a harness project-memory store exists, it is the canonical continuity system — repo facts, decisions, open loops, and treatment history live there.

9cba06db4b085578.translation: Role OS si integra con tale archivio quando è presente. Non lo sostituisce.
9cba06db4b085578.source: Role OS integrates with that store when present. It does not replace it.

8c80d6a5a7a0ecdd.translation: Trattamento completo e controllo del progetto

a09e011e4fc419c0.translation: Il trattamento completo è un protocollo canonico a 7 fasi definito nella memoria del progetto (⟦0⟧). Role OS gestisce e rivede i trattamenti utilizzando contratti di ruolo, passaggi di consegne e punti di controllo critici; non ridefinisce il protocollo.
a09e011e4fc419c0.source: Full treatment is a canonical 7-phase protocol defined in studio project memory (⟦0⟧). Role OS routes and reviews treatments using role contracts, handoffs, and critic gates — it does not redefine the protocol.

1ad14f9c6bb2e993.translation: **Shipcheck** è il controllo di qualità composto da 31 elementi che viene eseguito prima del trattamento completo. I controlli rigorosi A-D devono essere superati prima dell'inizio di qualsiasi trattamento. Riferimento canonico: ⟦0⟧.
1ad14f9c6bb2e993.source: **Shipcheck** is the 31-item quality gate that runs before full treatment. Hard gates A-D must pass before any treatment begins. Canonical reference: ⟦0⟧.

df26668f475c86d6.translation: Ordine: prima Shipcheck, poi trattamento completo. Nessuna versione 1.0.0 senza il superamento dei controlli rigorosi.
df26668f475c86d6.source: Order: Shipcheck first, then full treatment. No v1.0.0 without passing hard gates.

38e7b5f604e637a4.translation:
- Correzioni di una sola riga, errori di battitura o bug evidenti
- Ricerca esplorativa senza un output definito
- Lavoro che può essere svolto da una sola persona in 5 minuti
- Correzioni urgenti che devono essere implementate prima del completamento della catena di revisione

- Single-line fixes, typos, or obvious bugs
- Exploratory research with no defined output
- Work that fits in one person's head in 5 minutes
- Emergency hotfixes that need to ship before a review chain completes
- Projects where you want speed over structure

edf0caf55285f3fb.translation: Per impostazione predefinita, Role OS opera solo sul **file system locale**. Copia i modelli Markdown e scrive i file di pacchetto/verdetto/esecuzione nella directory ⟦0⟧ del repository. L'operazione predefinita non effettua richieste di rete, non gestisce segreti e non raccoglie dati di telemetria. Nessuna operazione pericolosa: tutte le scritture di file utilizzano per impostazione predefinita l'opzione "salta se esiste".
edf0caf55285f3fb.source: By default, Role OS operates on the **local filesystem only**. It copies markdown templates and writes packet/verdict/run files to your repository's ⟦0⟧ directory. Default operation makes no network requests, handles no secrets, and collects no telemetry. No dangerous operations — all file writes use skip-if-exists by default.

be37ceb8b9f6e27d.translation: Tre funzionalità **opzionali** accedono alla rete quando le si abilita esplicitamente:
be37ceb8b9f6e27d.source: Three **opt-in** features touch the network when you explicitly enable them:

aa45ef7b86997b96.translation:
- **⟦0⟧** — esegue comandi esterni tramite la CLI ⟦1⟧, che risolve gli identificatori di citazione rispetto alle API pubbliche di arXiv/Crossref (invia gli ID/URL delle citazioni in fase di verifica).
- **Livello specialista** (⟦2⟧, ruoli registrati) — invia richieste a ⟦3⟧ configurato in ⟦4⟧ (in genere un endpoint di modello locale).
- **Consultazione sul budget/conformità** (⟦5⟧ / ⟦6⟧) — invia il contesto del passaggio/chiamata di strumento a un modello locale tramite HTTP per ottenere un parere.
aa45ef7b86997b96.source:
- **⟦0⟧** — shells out to the external ⟦1⟧ CLI, which resolves citation identifiers against public arXiv/Crossref APIs (sends the citation IDs/URLs being verified).
- **Specialist tier** (⟦2⟧, registered roles) — POSTs dispatch prompts to the ⟦3⟧ you configure in ⟦4⟧ (typically a local model endpoint).
- **Budget / conformance consult** (⟦5⟧ / ⟦6⟧) — sends the step/tool-call context to a local model over HTTP for an advisory verdict.

71f9ba2f30174ccc.translation: Tutti e tre sono disattivati per impostazione predefinita e, in caso di errore, si comportano in modo deterministico a livello locale. Consultare [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) per l'elenco completo delle policy.
71f9ba2f30174ccc.source: All three are off by default and fail open to local deterministic behavior. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for the full policy.

c3b1feae0c86519c.translation: Schede di ricetta, giuria e calibrazione dei pacchetti
c3b1feae0c86519c.source: Recipe cards, the jury, and pack calibration

5c41291b27e1af80.translation: Un critico addestrato è efficace solo quanto i dati da cui ha tratto le sue conoscenze. Role OS registra questi dati su una scheda di ricetta, valuta un gruppo di critici e consente a un ciclo completato di migliorare la scelta del pacchetto. Nessuna di queste operazioni richiede l'utilizzo di un modello. Lo stesso file e lo stesso seme producono gli stessi risultati.
5c41291b27e1af80.source: A trained critic is only as good as the data it learned from. Role OS records that data on a recipe card, measures a panel of critics, and lets a finished run boost pack choice. None of this calls a model. The same file and the same seed produce the same numbers.

2a34a54e8951fda9.translation: ⟦0⟧ verifica una scheda (⟦1⟧). Nove controlli standard, ciascuno dei quali verifica un aspetto che può far sembrare un critico valido anche se non ha appreso le sue caratteristiche. Un controllo superato senza una misurazione rappresenta una lacuna. Una misurazione incoerente è un errore. ⟦2⟧ deve utilizzare il metodo ⟦3⟧. ⟦4⟧: quando entrambi i metodi di modifica vengono registrati e i loro intervalli non si sovrappongono, lo stato deve essere ⟦5⟧, altrimenti la verifica fallisce. ⟦6⟧ viene superato solo quando il suo intervallo di accuratezza si trova interamente al di sopra di 0,5.
2a34a54e8951fda9.source: ⟦0⟧ checks a card (⟦1⟧). Nine standard controls each guard a way a critic can look good without having learned its attribute. A passed control with no measure is a gap. An inconsistent measure is an error. ⟦2⟧ has to use the method ⟦3⟧. ⟦4⟧: when both edit methods are recorded and their intervals don't overlap, the status must be ⟦5⟧, or the check fails. ⟦6⟧ passes only when its accuracy interval lies entirely above 0.5.

bcaf9d5a80b76266.translation: Quel file è una scheda sintetica compilata, non un critico addestrato. La verifica stampa:
bcaf9d5a80b76266.source: That file is a filled synthetic card, not a trained critic. The check prints:

744f56a0c4b1fc01.translation: La nota è un dato di fatto, non una lacuna. ⟦0⟧ prende ⟦1⟧ e associa l'ID e l'hash della scheda a tale versione. Consultare il [manuale](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/recipe-cards/).
744f56a0c4b1fc01.source: The note is a fact, not a gap. ⟦0⟧ takes ⟦1⟧ and pins the card's id and hash on that version. See the [handbook](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/recipe-cards/).

27eb45ed24c158c1.translation: ⟦0⟧ mantiene un gruppo solo quando un intervallo nidificato e raggruppato indica che il gruppo supera il miglior singolo critico. In caso contrario, la decisione è che il critico è valido, oppure ⟦1⟧ se ci sono meno di 30 elementi o 10 gruppi. Un critico la cui scheda presenta un controllo standard fallito o irrisolto viene escluso, a meno che non sia ⟦2⟧. Un critico senza scheda viene comunque incluso, a meno che non sia ⟦3⟧. I punteggi non vengono mai invertiti. Lo stesso seme ripete gli stessi risultati.
27eb45ed24c158c1.source: ⟦0⟧ keeps a panel only when a nested group-clustered interval says the panel beats the best single critic. Otherwise the verdict is that critic, or ⟦1⟧ below 30 items or 10 groups. A critic whose card has a failed or unresolved standard control is left out unless ⟦2⟧. A critic with no card is still seated unless ⟦3⟧. Scores are never flipped. The same seed repeats the same numbers.

902a71bc4ff2887f.translation: Su questo file sintetico, la decisione è ⟦0⟧. echo e sharp commettono gli stessi errori, quindi la coerenza degli errori è 1,0000 e i nomi dei flag li identificano. Il flag non esclude nessuno dei due critici. L'intervallo nidificato è [-0,1000, 0,0000]. Tocca lo 0, quindi non si trova interamente al di sopra di 0 e, anche con --out, non scriverebbe alcun file di gruppo, perché --out scrive un file solo per una decisione di gruppo. Il [manuale](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/jury/) contiene il rapporto completo.
902a71bc4ff2887f.source: On this synthetic file the verdict is ⟦0⟧. echo and sharp make the same mistakes, so error consistency is 1.0000 and the duplicate flag names them. The flag does not drop either critic. The nested interval is [-0.1000, 0.0000]. It touches 0, so it does not lie entirely above 0, and even with --out it would write no panel file, because --out writes one only for a panel verdict. The [handbook](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/jury/) has the full report.

f0bf53d23f57b3db.translation: Quando un ciclo termina, Role OS aggiunge una riga di risultato. Lo stesso ID di ciclo non scrive una seconda riga. Dopo che un pacchetto ha almeno 5 risultati registrati, ogni ciclo completato con correzioni pari a 0 aggiunge +0,5 a quel pacchetto, con un limite massimo di +2. Il miglioramento non assegna mai a un pacchetto le parole chiave che non corrispondevano già. Il livello di confidenza rimane alto con 3 corrispondenze di parole chiave e medio con 2, ricavato dal punteggio delle parole chiave, non dal punteggio migliorato. I pesi di Role non cambiano. Le soglie di confidenza non cambiano. Il rapporto di calibrazione potrebbe suggerire di esaminare la soglia delle parole chiave. Role OS non applica tale suggerimento.
f0bf53d23f57b3db.source: When a run ends, Role OS appends one outcome line. The same run id does not write a second line. After a pack has at least 5 recorded outcomes, each completed run with corrections 0 adds +0.5 to that pack, capped at +2. The boost never names a pack the keywords did not already match. Confidence stays high at 3 keyword hits and medium at 2, taken from the keyword score, not from the boosted score. Role weights do not change. Confidence thresholds do not change. The calibration report may suggest looking at the keyword cutoff. Role OS does not apply that suggestion.

cac103b6977bf135.translation: ⟦0⟧ disattiva il miglioramento. La registrazione continua.
cac103b6977bf135.source: ⟦0⟧ turns the boost off. Recording continues.

f2520395047237de.translation: Valuta i critici addestrati. Mantiene un gruppo solo quando supera il miglior singolo critico su gruppi di test. I controlli di ricetta falliti o irrisolti escludono un critico.

25293be8952deead.translation: Crea esecuzioni, esegui il debug con lo stato tracciato, completa/fallisci con una segnalazione accurata. Propagazione dei passaggi bloccati, avvisi di escalation al di fuori della catena, riapertura dell'ultimo passaggio.

5121d212b4ae10e7.source: ⟦0⟧ decides mission vs pack vs free routing automatically. Fallback ladder with confidence scores, alternatives, and composite detection.

36ce7557d24c61f1.translation: ⟦0⟧ crea esecuzioni basate su disco. ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧. Interventi: reindirizzamento, escalation, riprova, blocco, riapertura. Guida specifica per ogni passaggio. Misurazione dell'attrito.
36ce7557d24c61f1.source: ⟦0⟧ creates disk-backed runs. ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧. Interventions: reroute, escalate, retry, block, reopen. Step-local guidance. Friction measurement.

7c38965a4c97114f.translation: Architettura a due livelli: verità (schemi nativi del ruolo, atomi di provenienza, grafico di controversie incrociate) + rendering (5 voci distinte, divieti lessicali, trascrizione del dibattito). I collegamenti di traccia dimostrano che ogni affermazione resa corrisponde a un atomo di verità. Esecuzione di successo verificata.
7c38965a4c97114f.source: Two-layer architecture: truth (role-native schemas, provenance atoms, cross-exam dispute graph) + render (5 distinct voices, lexical bans, debate transcript). Trace links prove every rendered claim maps to a truth atom. Golden run proven.

033a8cef120ed3ef.translation: Audit del repository basato su manifest: decomponi il repository in componenti, assegna N auditor + M auditor di verifica della verità + K auditor dei punti di confine dal grafico delle dipendenze, sintetizza in un verdetto classificato e in un piano d'azione. Assegnazione dinamica che si adatta alle dimensioni del repository (formula 2N + K + 3). Nativo per l'esecutore, con convalida degli artefatti a ogni passaggio.
033a8cef120ed3ef.source: Manifest-scaled repo audit: decompose repo into components, dispatch N auditors + M test truth auditors + K seam auditors from dependency graph, synthesize into ranked verdict and action plan. Dynamic dispatch scales with repo size (2N + K + 3 formula). Runner-native with artifact validation at every step.

9bd43a7a152a1d75.translation: Convergenza multi-pass: tre fasi di controllo (bug/sicurezza → proattivo → umanizzazione) quindi fase delle funzionalità. Proprietà esclusiva dei file, controlli di build dopo ogni iterazione, checkpoint dell'utente. Il rilevamento automatico del dominio genera i manifest. Collegamento di evidenza ai laboratori di test interni.
9bd43a7a152a1d75.source: Multi-pass convergence: three health stages (bug/security → proactive → humanization) then feature pass. Exclusive file ownership, build gates after every wave, user checkpoints. Domain auto-detection generates manifests. Evidence bridge to dogfood-labs.

7ca3b170a0d4df8e.translation: Consegna completa di una funzionalità: ambito → specifica → implementazione → test → revisione
7ca3b170a0d4df8e.source: Full feature delivery: scope → spec → implement → test → review

6a729a1fe5dc7748.translation: Diagnosi della causa principale, correzione, test, verifica
6a729a1fe5dc7748.source: Diagnose root cause, fix, test, verify

0ebe78dacffdcbdb.translation: Controllo finale + rifinitura + documentazione + verifica CI + revisione
0ebe78dacffdcbdb.source: Shipcheck + polish + docs + CI verify + review

e8c5d802291b0f6e.translation: Scrivi/aggiorna la documentazione, le note di rilascio

b5895ebb99ea88f6.translation: Modello delle minacce, audit, correzione delle vulnerabilità, ri-audit, verifica
b5895ebb99ea88f6.source: Threat model, audit, fix vulnerabilities, re-audit, verify

40f2d48a15927868.translation: Formula la domanda, effettua la ricerca, documenta i risultati, decidi
40f2d48a15927868.source: Frame question, research, document findings, decide

92332dd85c81b65f.translation: Indagine strutturata e multi-prospettica con disaccordo e verdetto tracciabili
92332dd85c81b65f.source: Structured multi-perspective inquiry with traceable disagreement and verdict

265befe6bbaed2cd.translation: Audit del repository basato su manifest: il numero di worker si adatta al grafico del repository tramite l'assegnazione dinamica
265befe6bbaed2cd.source: Manifest-backed repo audit — worker count scales with repo graph via dynamic dispatch

c2dcb19071ddf011.translation: Convergenza multi-pass: controllo-a → controllo-b → controllo-c → funzionalità → sintesi finale
c2dcb19071ddf011.source: Multi-pass convergence: health-a → health-b → health-c → feature → final synthesis

dac702fc827f8051.translation: Ogni missione include definizioni parziali e oneste: quando il lavoro si interrompe, il sistema documenta ciò che è stato completato e ciò che rimane, invece di fingere di aver completato tutto.
dac702fc827f8051.source: Each mission includes honest-partial definitions — when work stalls, the system documents what was completed and what remains instead of bluffing completion.

962131a4d8b38987.translation: Non si tratta di "brainstorming con l'IA". La missione di brainstorming è costituita da **ruoli specializzati definiti dalla legge, con disaccordo tracciabile e risultati che portano a un verdetto.**
962131a4d8b38987.source: Not "AI brainstorming." The brainstorm mission is **specialized roles under law, with traceable disagreement and verdict-bearing output.**

471dfacbc3ce391b.translation: - **Livello 1 (verità):** Quattro analisti emettono schemi nativi del ruolo (ContextMap, UserValueMap, MechanicsMap, PositioningMap): non si tratta di prosa condivisa. Ogni ruolo applica un divieto di punti ciechi: frasi proibite, tipi di affermazioni proibite, partizioni di input filtrate. Gli atomi contengono la provenienza. Un grafico di esame incrociato diretto produce sfide mirate. Gli analisti originali difendono, restringono o ritrattano sotto pressione.
471dfacbc3ce391b.source: - **Layer 1 (truth):** Four analysts emit role-native schemas (ContextMap, UserValueMap, MechanicsMap, PositioningMap) — not shared prose. Each role is blindspot-enforced: forbidden phrases, forbidden claim kinds, filtered input partitions. Atoms carry provenance. A directed cross-examination graph produces targeted challenges. Original analysts defend, narrow, or retract under pressure.

12cd19e280adfad8.translation: - **Livello 2 (rendering):** Cinque voci umane distinte (Boundary Memo, Field Notes, System Sketch, Claim Brief, Cross-Exam Transcript) con divieti lessicali che impediscono la convergenza delle voci. La sintesi utilizza la verità, non la prosa resa. Entrambi i livelli sono sempre disponibili.
12cd19e280adfad8.source: - **Layer 2 (render):** Five distinct human voices (Boundary Memo, Field Notes, System Sketch, Claim Brief, Cross-Exam Transcript) with lexical bans preventing voice convergence. Synthesis consumes truth, never rendered prose. Both layers always available.

8a0a4e4143b8b52f.translation: - **Catena di custodia:** Ogni frase resa traccia un atomo del livello di verità. Le direttive di sintesi citano gli atomi. Gli obiettivi dell'esame incrociato sono ID di affermazioni reali. Il grafico delle controversie è il prodotto, non la prosa.
8a0a4e4143b8b52f.source: - **Chain of custody:** Every rendered sentence traces back to a truth-layer atom. Synthesis directions cite atoms. Cross-exam targets real claim IDs. The dispute graph is the product, not the prose.

8af2420f144f8f67.translation: **Dimostrato:** Esecuzione di successo v0.4: catena di custodia completa verificata. Consulta [⟦0⟧](examples/golden-run.md) per la catena completa degli artefatti.
8af2420f144f8f67.source: **Proven:** v0.4 golden run — full chain of custody verified. See [⟦0⟧](examples/golden-run.md) for the complete artifact chain.

b26a24398865245b.translation: Non si tratta di una scansione superficiale. La missione di audit approfondito **decompone un repository in componenti delimitati e assegna auditor specializzati in una scala determinata dal grafico delle dipendenze del repository stesso.**
b26a24398865245b.source: Not a surface scan. The deep audit mission **decomposes a repo into bounded components and dispatches specialist auditors at a scale determined by the repo's own dependency graph.**

d0b5aece20c90a15.translation:
- **Assegnazione dinamica:** il numero di worker non è fisso. Un repository con 10 componenti e 5 cluster di confine produce 28 passaggi (2 × 10 + 5 + 3). Un repository con 3 componenti produce 12. La formula di scalabilità è ⟦0⟧, dove N = componenti, K = confini.
- **Pacchetti basati su manifest:** un ⟦1⟧ definisce i componenti (con percorsi dei file, conteggi di righe, descrizioni) e i confini (da/a con descrizioni dell'interfaccia). Ogni auditor riceve solo il proprio pacchetto.
- **Quattro archetipi di ruolo:** Auditor dei componenti (verità del codice per modulo), Auditor di verifica della verità (test che dimostrano vs test che esistono), Auditor dei punti di confine (confini di integrazione dal grafico delle dipendenze), Sintetizzatore di audit (verdetto classificato + piano d'azione da tutti i pacchetti).
- **Convalida degli artefatti a ogni passaggio:** ⟦2⟧ viene eseguito al termine di ogni passaggio in entrambi i percorsi di esecuzione. I risultati vengono allegati agli oggetti di passaggio. Il sistema sa se ogni artefatto ha soddisfatto il suo contratto.
- **Onestà parziale:** quando il budget o l'ambito bloccano il completamento, i risultati per componente sono validi individualmente. Il sistema sintetizza ciò che è stato completato, senza mai fingere una copertura completa.
d0b5aece20c90a15.source:
- **Dynamic dispatch** — worker count is not fixed. A 10-component repo with 5 boundary clusters produces 28 steps (2×10 + 5 + 3). A 3-component repo produces 12. The scaling formula is ⟦0⟧ where N = components, K = boundaries.
- **Manifest-backed parcels** — an ⟦1⟧ defines components (with file paths, line counts, descriptions) and boundaries (from/to with interface descriptions). Each auditor receives only its parcel.
- **Four role archetypes** — Component Auditor (code truth per module), Test Truth Auditor (tests that prove vs tests that exist), Seam Auditor (integration boundaries from the dependency graph), Audit Synthesizer (ranked verdict + action plan from all parcels).
- **Artifact validation at every step** — ⟦2⟧ fires on every step completion in both execution paths. Results attached to step objects. The system knows whether each artifact met its contract.
- **Honest partial** — when budget or scope blocks completion, per-component findings are individually valid. The system synthesizes from whatever completed, never bluffs full coverage.

70055c06f86b9331.translation: **Dimostrato:** Esecuzione di prova nativa per l'esecutore: 18 test su un manifest reale, ciclo di vita completo verificato, inclusa la riapertura dell'escalation e il fallimento parziale. La formula di scalabilità è stata verificata per i manifest con 3/6/10/15 componenti.
70055c06f86b9331.source: **Proven:** Runner-native proof run — 18 tests against real manifest, full lifecycle verified including escalation re-opening and partial failure. Scaling formula verified for 3/6/10/15-component manifests.

c5aaa39dbd944c53.translation: Missione di swarm di test interni

853a2ae5d7857783.translation: Non si tratta di un linting a passaggio singolo. La missione di swarm di test interni **esegue un protocollo di convergenza multi-pass che porta un repository da "funzionante" a "pronto per la produzione" attraverso tre fasi di controllo e la consegna iterativa delle funzionalità.**
853a2ae5d7857783.source: Not a one-pass linter. The dogfood swarm mission **runs a multi-pass convergence protocol that moves a repo from "works" to "production-ready" through three health stages and iterative feature delivery.**

9a3ce0ca4c6df7ea.translation:
- **Controllo sanitario in tre fasi** — La fase A corregge bug e problemi di sicurezza (ciclo fino a 0 CRITICAL + 0 HIGH). La fase B applica misure di sicurezza proattive (gli utenti esaminano i risultati). La fase C rende il codice più intuitivo — messaggi di errore che aiutano gli utenti, feedback sulla riconnessione, stati di caricamento, accessibilità. Ogni fase è una prospettiva distinta, non la stessa scansione ripetuta.
- **Proprietà esclusiva dei file** — ogni agente di dominio possiede file specifici tramite ⟦0⟧. Nessun agente modifica lo stesso file. Nessun conflitto di unione. Nessun sovraccarico di coordinamento.
- **Controlli di build** — lint, controllo dei tipi e test devono essere superati dopo ogni ciclo. Il sistema rileva automaticamente il sistema di build (Node, Rust, Python, Go) ed esegue i comandi corretti.
- **Punti di controllo utente** — Health-B e la fase di funzionalità richiedono l'approvazione esplicita dell'utente prima dell'esecuzione. Il sistema presenta i risultati e l'utente decide cosa costruire.
- **Convergenza iterativa** — le fasi si ripetono con cicli finché non vengono soddisfatte le condizioni di uscita o raggiunto il numero massimo di iterazioni. Ogni ciclo riesamina tutto da zero per individuare eventuali regressioni introdotte dalle correzioni precedenti.
- **Rilevamento automatico del dominio** — ⟦1⟧ rileva il tipo di repository (CLI, web, desktop, MCP, monorepo) e genera assegnazioni di dominio non sovrapposte.
9a3ce0ca4c6df7ea.source:
- **Three-stage health pass** — Stage A fixes bugs and security issues (loop until 0 CRITICAL + 0 HIGH). Stage B applies proactive hardening (user reviews findings). Stage C humanizes the codebase — error messages that help users, reconnection feedback, loading states, accessibility. Each stage is a distinct lens, not the same scan repeated.
- **Exclusive file ownership** — every domain agent owns specific files via ⟦0⟧. No two agents edit the same file. No merge conflicts. No coordination overhead.
- **Build gates** — lint + typecheck + test must pass after every wave. The system auto-detects the build system (Node, Rust, Python, Go) and runs the right commands.
- **User checkpoints** — Health-B and the feature pass require explicit user approval before execution. The system presents findings, the user decides what to build.
- **Iterative convergence** — stages loop with wave loops until exit conditions are met or max iterations reached. Each wave re-audits from scratch to catch regressions introduced by previous fixes.
- **Domain auto-detection** — ⟦1⟧ detects repo type (CLI, web, desktop, MCP, monorepo) and generates non-overlapping domain assignments.

6d24869523e89b7b.translation: **Provato:** claude-collaborate (2026-03-28) — 35→129 test, 106 problemi di controllo sanitario risolti, versione v1.1.0 rilasciata. Protocollo v2.0 con 9 fasi.
6d24869523e89b7b.source: **Proven:** claude-collaborate (2026-03-28) — 35→129 tests, 106 health findings fixed, v1.1.0 shipped. Protocol v2.0 with 9 phases.

af19264b3d97e374.translation: Stabile e rilasciato. Consultare il [REGISTRO DELLE MODIFICHE](CHANGELOG.md) per la cronologia completa delle versioni e le modifiche apportate in ogni rilascio.
af19264b3d97e374.source: Stable and shipping. See the [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md) for full version history and what changed in each release.

6bcae11f63b5ade4.translation: Uma camada operacional nativa de repositório que aloca, roteia, valida e executa o trabalho de agentes de codificação por meio de 61 contratos de função especializados. Cria pacotes de tarefas, monta a equipe certa a partir de uma correspondência de funções avaliada, detecta falhas antes da execução, roteia automaticamente a recuperação quando o trabalho é bloqueado ou rejeitado e exige evidências estruturadas em cada verificação. Inclui despacho dinâmico para missões de escala de manifesto — um repositório de 10 componentes se torna automaticamente 28 etapas de auditoria, em vez de 6.
6bcae11f63b5ade4.source: A repo-native operating layer that staffs, routes, validates, and runs coding-agent work through 61 specialized role contracts. Creates task packets, assembles the right team from scored role matching, detects broken chains before execution, auto-routes recovery when work is blocked or rejected, and requires structured evidence in every verdict. Includes dynamic dispatch for manifest-scaled missions — a 10-component repo automatically becomes 28 auditor steps, not 6.

883b568dcc0e5546.translation: O adaptador Claude Code é lançado (⟦0⟧ cria ⟦1⟧). Os contratos são em formato Markdown, que qualquer estrutura de codificação pode consumir — este repositório não afirma que um segundo adaptador já está em execução.
883b568dcc0e5546.source: Claude Code adapter ships (⟦0⟧ scaffolds ⟦1⟧). The contracts are markdown any coding harness can consume — this repo does not claim a second adapter already runs.

5553b0eb7b8f8887.translation: O Role OS é a maneira profissional de alocar o trabalho de agentes de codificação. Ele evita as falhas específicas que os fluxos de trabalho genéricos de IA produzem:
5553b0eb7b8f8887.source: Role OS is the professional way to staff coding-agent work. It prevents the specific failures that generic AI workflows produce:

c3ef9e99669c9356.translation:
- **Desvio** — as funções permanecem dentro de seus limites. O produto não é redesenhado. O frontend não redefine o escopo. O backend não inventa a direção do produto.
- **Conclusão falsa** — a definição de "concluído" é concreta. O trabalho que oculta lacunas, ignora a verificação ou resolve um problema diferente é rejeitado.
- **Contaminação** — projetos ramificados ou herdados carregam resíduos de identidade. O Role OS detecta e rejeita o desvio entre projetos na terminologia, elementos visuais e modelos mentais.
- **Progresso baseado em "vibes"** — cada transferência é estruturada. Cada verificação está vinculada a evidências. "Parece concluído" não é um estado válido.
c3ef9e99669c9356.source:
- **Drift** — roles stay in lane. Product doesn't redesign. Frontend doesn't redefine scope. Backend doesn't invent product direction.
- **False completion** — the done definition is concrete. Work that hides gaps, skips verification, or solves a different problem gets rejected.
- **Contamination** — forked or inherited projects carry identity residue. Role OS detects and rejects cross-project drift in terminology, visuals, and mental models.
- **Vibes-based progress** — every handoff is structured. Every verdict ties to evidence. "It feels done" is not a valid state.

698cd4bcd87168f5.translation: Descreva sua tarefa. O Role OS decide automaticamente o nível correto de orquestração.
698cd4bcd87168f5.source: Describe your task. Role OS decides the right level of orchestration automatically.

7e68d834e230000b.translation:
1. **Missão** — quando a tarefa corresponde a um fluxo de trabalho recorrente comprovado (correção de bug, tratamento, lançamento de recurso, documentação, segurança, pesquisa, brainstorming, auditoria aprofundada, teste em grupo). Cadeia de funções conhecida, fluxo de artefatos, ramificações de escalonamento e definições honestas e parciais.
2. **Pacote** — quando a tarefa pertence a uma família conhecida, mas não tem a forma completa de uma missão. 10 pacotes de equipe calibrados com seleção automática e proteções contra incompatibilidades.
3. **Roteamento livre** — quando a tarefa é nova, mista ou incerta. Avalia todas as 61 funções em relação ao conteúdo do pacote e monta uma cadeia dinâmica.
7e68d834e230000b.source:
1. **Mission** — when the task matches a proven recurring workflow (bugfix, treatment, feature-ship, docs, security, research, brainstorm, deep-audit, dogfood-swarm). Known role chain, artifact flow, escalation branches, and honest-partial definitions.
2. **Pack** — when the task is a known family but not a full mission shape. 10 calibrated team packs with auto-selection and mismatch guards.
3. **Free routing** — when the task is novel, mixed, or uncertain. Scores all 61 roles against packet content and assembles a dynamic chain.

1e768535d62bc629.translation: O sistema nunca força o trabalho por meio da abstração errada. Ele explica por que escolheu cada nível e oferece alternativas.
1e768535d62bc629.source: The system never forces work through the wrong abstraction. It explains why it chose each level and offers alternatives.

6c3f2042d85dee5d.translation: As execuções são persistidas em disco (⟦0⟧), para que as sessões interrompidas sejam retomadas de forma limpa. Cada etapa inclui orientação para o operador: o que produzir, as seções necessárias e as condições de parada.
6c3f2042d85dee5d.source: Runs persist to disk (⟦0⟧), so interrupted sessions resume cleanly. Every step includes operator guidance: what to produce, required sections, and stop conditions.

25aa9b442094d903.translation:
1. **Cada função produz uma transferência** — saída estruturada com itens de evidência que reduzem a ambiguidade para a próxima função.
2. **O crítico avalia em relação ao contrato** — aceita, rejeita ou bloqueia com base em evidências estruturadas, não em impressões.
3. **O roteamento de recuperação é feito automaticamente** — o trabalho bloqueado ou rejeitado é roteado para o resolvedor correto com um motivo, tipo de recuperação e artefato necessário.
25aa9b442094d903.source:
1. **Each role produces a handoff** — structured output with evidence items that reduce ambiguity for the next role
2. **Critic reviews against contract** — accepts, rejects, or blocks based on structured evidence, not impression
3. **Recovery routes automatically** — blocked or rejected work gets routed to the right resolver with a reason, recovery type, and required artifact

d0cdbdcce5529da2.translation: O Role OS pode consultar um **analista de orçamento de tokens** local para cada etapa de despacho e anexar uma previsão de gastos consultiva ao manifesto — opcional (⟦0⟧), consultiva (nunca bloqueia um despacho) e com fallback para uma linha de base determinística. Desativado por padrão; a previsão é local e gratuita. Consulte o [manual](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/specialist-budget/).
d0cdbdcce5529da2.source: Role OS can consult a local **Token Budget Analyst** for each dispatch step and attach an advisory spend forecast to the manifest — opt-in (⟦0⟧), advisory (it never blocks a dispatch), and fail-open to a deterministic baseline. Off by default; the forecast is local and free to run. See the [handbook](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/specialist-budget/).

6a0d1be5789389d3.translation: O Role OS verifica e controla as chamadas de ferramentas na junção ⟦0⟧ — de forma determinística, sem nenhum modelo no caminho crítico:
6a0d1be5789389d3.source: Role OS verifies and gates tool calls at the ⟦0⟧ seam — deterministically, with no model on the hot path:

927b3ff37bffd347.translation:
- **Observador de conformidade** (consultivo, com fallback) — um esquema determinístico + um limite de contrato computável verifica uma chamada proposta em relação ao seu contrato de ferramenta catalogado e anexa uma avaliação consultiva sobre uma chamada comprovadamente não conforme; nunca bloqueia. Um limite LLM opcional (⟦0⟧) lida com o resíduo genuinamente semântico.
- **Controle de capacidade** (bloqueio, opcional ⟦1⟧, padrão DESATIVADO) — privilégio mínimo determinístico em ações *irreversíveis* (publicação em npm/PyPI, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, edições de repositório, implantação em Páginas). Uma ação controlada é negada, a menos que o diretor tenha concedido sua capacidade em ⟦4⟧, para que uma etapa errada — um erro honesto ou um erro injetado — não possa acionar uma ação irreversível não autorizada. O complemento preventivo da regra de compensador nomeado. Consulte o [manual](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/).
927b3ff37bffd347.source:
- **Conformance watcher** (advisory, fail-open) — a deterministic schema + computable-contract floor checks a proposed call against its catalogued tool-contract and attaches an advisory verdict on a *proven* nonconformant call; it never blocks. An opt-in LLM ceiling (⟦0⟧) handles the genuinely-semantic residue.
- **Capability gate** (fail-closed, opt-in ⟦1⟧, default OFF) — deterministic least-privilege on *irreversible* actions (npm/PyPI publish, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, repo edits, Pages deploy). A gated action is denied unless the director granted its capability in ⟦4⟧, so a wrong step — an honest mistake or an injected one — can't trigger an unauthorized irreversible action. The preventive complement to the named-compensator rule. See the [handbook](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/).

ff8c12c9fc7d9ea3.translation: Cada função tem um **dossiê** — uma ficha de personagem que também serve como configuração em tempo de execução. Seis aptidões (Rigor, Ritmo, Amplitude, Ceticismo, Autonomia, Franqueza) são mapeadas para controles de despacho reais; uma camada de **disposição** de oito arquétipos (Cético, Construtor, Investigador, Inovador…) carrega uma instrução comportamental; e cada função tem um retrato e uma classificação. Navegue por toda a equipe como uma galeria (⟦0⟧) — o radar de cada função mostra sua configuração ajustada em relação ao seu ideal canônico.
ff8c12c9fc7d9ea3.source: Every role has a **dossier** — a character sheet that doubles as run-time config. Six aptitudes (Rigor, Pace, Range, Skepticism, Autonomy, Candor) map to real dispatch knobs; an eight-archetype **disposition** layer (Skeptic, Builder, Investigator, Maverick…) carries a behavioral instruction; and each role has a painted portrait and a grade. Browse the whole crew as a gallery (⟦0⟧) — each role's radar shows its tuned build against its canonical ideal.

67d31a1ba027d2e7.translation: Quando uma função tem um dossiê, o despacho injeta uma **Postura Operacional** — a instrução comportamental da disposição mais uma linha de postura das aptidões da função — para que a ficha realmente configure a função. Opcional e aditivo: as funções sem um dossiê se comportam exatamente como antes. Consulte o [manual](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/crew-dossier/).
67d31a1ba027d2e7.source: When a role has a dossier, dispatch injects an **Operating Posture** — the disposition's behavioral instruction plus a posture line from the role's aptitudes — so the sheet actually configures the role. Opt-in and additive: roles without a dossier behave exactly as before. See the [handbook](https://mcp-tool-shop-org.github.io/role-os/handbook/crew-dossier/).

4c025aae5d53b028.translation: O estado de implantação em toda a organização (fila, decisões, registros de auditoria, pacotes de bloqueio por repositório) reside em um repositório **privado**, interno da organização (⟦0⟧) separado. Este repositório é o produto; aquele repositório é o estado operacional.
4c025aae5d53b028.source: Org-wide rollout state (queue, decisions, audit records, per-repo lock packets) lives in a separate **private**, org-internal repo (⟦0⟧). This repo is the product; that repo is operational state.

e85b1bc9cf43a280.translation: O Role OS não possui nem duplica a camada de memória. Onde existe uma loja de memória de projeto de estrutura, ela é o sistema de continuidade canônico — fatos do repositório, decisões, ciclos abertos e histórico de tratamento residem lá.

2eb8fcd1b2ed54c6.translation: Por padrão, o Role OS opera apenas no **sistema de arquivos local**.
